actions.importTitle: Import the forms and results of Jahia Forms into this site

import.title: Import Jahia Forms results
import.description: Bring the results of the forms of a Jahia Forms export into this site.
import.dropzone: Drop the export of the site's formFactory node here, a .zip file
import.fileHint: Take the export in the Repository explorer: right-click the site's formFactory node, Export, then Export Zip with live content. Up to {{max}} MB.

report.nothing: Nothing to import: every form and every submission is already in this site.
report.filesMissing: {{count}} file(s) not in the export, left behind
report.failed: {{count}} not written, see the import log

done.title: Import done
done.created: The created forms are unpublished: review each one, see what its Notes ask to review, then publish it.

error.notZip: The file must be a .zip export
error.tooLarge: The file is larger than {{max}} MB
error.unexpected: Something went wrong, see the server log

attach.pickForm: Pick a form of the site
attach.noForms: The site has no form yet
attach.mapping: Where the values of each field land
attach.noFields: This form has no field: every value keeps its name
attach.conflict: Two fields cannot land under the same name, nor under the name of another field of the source: {{names}}
attach.unmatched: {{count}} value(s) match no option of this field: {{values}}

plan.resultsOnly: Its submissions show on this page, without a form.
plan.created: Creates the form, unpublished, in the Imported from Jahia Forms folder, with its submissions.
plan.attached: Its submissions join the results of "{{name}}".
plan.attachPending: Pick the form its submissions join.
plan.found: Already imported: its new submissions join "{{name}}".
plan.skipped: Nothing is imported. Importing the same export again proposes it again.

outcome.resultsOnly: On this page, without a form

field.setting: Its {{setting}} setting is not carried over: a {{type}} field has none
field.createdAsFallback: Created as a {{type}} field: the {{preferred}} field is not installed here
field.createdAsNearest: Created as a {{type}} field, the closest: Formidable has no {{kind}} field
field.createdAsText: Created as a text field: Formidable has no equivalent of {{source}}
field.logic: Its conditional logic is not carried over: rebuild it
field.prefillOther: Its prefill ({{prefill}}) is not carried over: map the field to the visitor profile instead
field.prefillAlreadyMapped: Its second prefill, from {{property}}, is not carried over: the field takes one mapping to the visitor profile
field.prefillNoIntegration: Not mapped to the visitor profile property {{property}}: the jExperience integration is not installed
field.prefillNotMappable: Not mapped to the visitor profile property {{property}}: a {{type}} field cannot be mapped
field.profilePrefilled: Mapped to the visitor profile property {{property}}, prefilled from it, {{after}} once filled
field.profileMapped: Mapped to the visitor profile property {{property}}, without prefill
field.rule: Its {{rule}} rule is not carried over: a {{type}} field has no such rule
field.ruleMessage: The custom message of its {{rule}} rule is not carried over
field.fileTypes: Its accepted file types ({{types}}) are not carried over: set them by hand
field.noChoices: No options in the export: add them by hand
field.noCountries: No countries in the export: add the options by hand, or declare a country options source
field.termsLink: The link to the terms ({{link}}) is not carried over: add it to the statement
field.prefillUnknownProperty: Not mapped to the visitor profile property {{property}}: jCustomer has no such property. Create it, then map the field
field.prefillIncompatible: Not mapped to the visitor profile property {{property}}: its type does not fit a {{type}} field
field.profileUnchecked: Mapped to the visitor profile property {{property}}, unchecked: jCustomer could not be reached. Check that the property exists

form.fromLabels: Rebuilt from the labels of its results: Jahia Forms no longer holds the form
form.submitterMail: The mail to the submitter became a notification without recipient: complete or remove it
form.redirect: The page redirect (to {{target}} on the source site) is not carried over: Formidable has no redirect yet
form.action: The action {{action}} is not carried over: Formidable has no equivalent
form.notSaved: Jahia Forms did not save its submissions: add Save to JCR to keep them
form.mailCopies: The CC and BCC recipients of the notification ({{copies}}) are not carried over
form.mailBody: The body of the notification mail is not carried over
form.saveForLater: "Save the form for later" is not carried over: Formidable has no such feature
form.constraints: The submission limits are not carried over: Formidable has no such feature
form.captchaOn: Captcha turned on, with the captcha of this instance
form.captchaOff: Captcha not turned on: this instance has none, set one up then add it to the form
form.passwordDropped: The password field {{field}} is not recreated: it would be stored and mailed in clear
form.contentDisplayDropped: The content display {{field}} is not recreated: it submits nothing
form.redirectNoTarget: The redirect is not carried over: Formidable has no redirect yet

submission.keptUnderSourceName: {{field}}: kept under its Forms name {{name}}, the form holds no field for it
submission.notConverted: {{field}}: {{count}} value(s) kept as stored, they could not be converted
submission.consentUnknown: {{field}}: {{count}} value(s) kept as stored, neither the accepted nor the refused text
submission.duplicateTarget: {{field}}: dropped, another answer of the submission fills the same field
submission.fileMissing: The file {{file}} is not in the export: left behind
submission.writeFailed: Not written: {{reason}}. Importing the same export again tries it again
submission.noForm: From the results {{form}}, which no form of the export matches: not imported

profile.title: Mapped to the visitor profile (jExperience)
profile.unchecked: not checked, jCustomer could not be reached

field.prefillUnknownProperty: jCustomer has no such property: create it, then map the field
field.prefillIncompatible: its type does not fit this field
field.prefillNoIntegration: the jExperience integration is not installed
field.prefillNotMappable: this field type cannot be mapped

profile.hint: You can review these mappings after the import, in the jExperience section of each field.
profile.exists: the property exists, the mapping is written

markdown.title: Jahia Forms import log
markdown.stopped: The import stopped before its end: {{reason}}. What it wrote stays; import the same export again to go on.
